title: Hornado
description: Hornado is a dish from Ecuador featuring pork leg, garlic, potato, red onion. This home-sized recipe records each ingredient at the step where it is used.

steps.instruction: Combine the seasoning ingredients and coat the main protein or vegetables. Rest covered in the refrigerator for about 90 minutes.
Roast the already seasoned food in a preheated oven until tender and safely cooked, using a thermometer for meat or poultry.
Grill the marinated portions from the preceding steps, turning to cook evenly and checking the safe internal temperature.
Arrange the fully cooked and prepared parts of the dish on plates or in the intended serving vessel, adding the listed toppings or accompaniments just before serving.
